title: Laredo Police to Host First-Ever Blue Santa 5K to Buy Christmas Gifts for Local Kids

content:
The Laredo Police Department is lacing up for a first: the department will host its first-ever Blue Santa 5K on Saturday, Dec. 5, at the Sames Auto Arena, raising money to buy Christmas gifts for children across Laredo.

The run supports the department's annual Blue Santa program, which provides Christmas gifts to children in the community. Money raised through the 5K will go toward gifts for children whose families sign up for the program, according to the department.

Registration is open now. Entry is $35 per runner, or $25 for the 1-mile walk, and every participant receives a Blue Santa Christmas hat.

"Anyone can participate whether you're a runner or a walker or simply you just want to go and be there with the community," Dora Aguilar of the Laredo Police Department said.

The 5K is a new fundraising arm of a program Laredo already knows well. Webb Watch 956 has previously reported on Blue Santa gift signups for families; the December race gives residents another way to support the same effort — by running, walking, or simply showing up.

The department has not yet announced a start time for the Dec. 5 race. Families who want to sign a child up for Blue Santa gifts should check with the Laredo Police Department for the latest signup information.

Source: Laredo Police Department.

Webb Watch 956
